newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent firms on small corrective bounce.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent firms on small corrective bounce.

text.p: IPE Brent futures edged off yearly spot lows on Tuesday as the market consolidated after the substantial losses of the last two sessions, traders said.
July Brent was at $17.73 a barrel by 1015 GMT, up 17 cents on the day after closing at $17.53/17.60 a barrel on SIMEX.
June gas oil was up $1.25 at $161.25 a tonne.
Brokers said the market had shied away from its session highs after hitting resistance at around $17.78 a barrel.
They said players appeared reluctant to push higher ahead of the weekly release of American Petroleum Institute (API) U.S. oil stock data, due after the close of trade on Tuesday.
"People are reluctant to go long ahead of the API figures as they have been quite influential recently," one trader said.
Last week's API data showed U.S. crude oil stocks rose 1.40 million barrels in the week to May 23, while distillate stocks were up 3.32 million barrels. Gasoline stocks fell 1.12 million barrels.
Gas oil also moved higher in Brent's wake.
Brokers said there was some buying ahead of the U.S. open but if there was a sell-off on NYMEX, the market here would soon turn down too.
"Technically this market is very bearish," another trader said. -- Paul Carrel, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
